title: Default-off direct-main-root child-credit development pair

terminal_pair_audit.signed_zero_note: Every production stage: expected/loaded row-bound hash differences exactly explained by 1296 lower and 9 upper negative zeros becoming positive zero; exact elementwise equality, no tolerance expansion
terminal_pair_audit.method: Independent retained-artifact, raw-log and arithmetic audit; no fresh numerical execution

decision.development_gate: At least 20% reduction in both aggregate solver-process wall and standalone-equivalent E2E, valid 1% completions and actual mechanism activation
decision.result_scope: one seed, one off-then-on pair; host noise and order effects unquantified

protocol.custom_model: preventive DC unit commitment; input-listed line-outage security; original objective and penalties unchanged

timing_definition.solver_process_wall: Sum of exact solver-child launch-to-reap wall intervals for LP and MIP; nested heuristic time is not added again
timing_definition.standalone_equivalent_e2e: Per-arm interval beginning before source/runtime checks and ending after checks plus durable summary, plus the full common Python/setup/archival interval; this is an in-program standalone-equivalent measure, not a separate cold OS process
timing_definition.receipt_and_pair_archival: Arm completion receipts follow per-arm E2E. The retained pair interval includes those receipts but is sampled before final pair calculations and pair.json serialization; it does not include final pair archival despite the raw field name.
timing_definition.pair_interval_endpoint: After arm completion receipts; before pair comparison/mechanism calculations and final pair.json serialization

comparison.e2e_comparison_scope: common source/runtime archival and Python-definition startup charged in full to each standalone-equivalent arm

mechanism_summary.scope: Source-pinned heuristic telemetry only; never a global lower bound or separate process-time debit

timing.timing: starts before source/runtime verification; stops after all checks and durable summary; this timing receipt is pair archival

resources.parent_rss_scope: cumulative lifetime peak of shared pair Python parent; second arm may inherit an earlier peak

numerical_gap.lower_rounding_allowance_reason: half of 12-significant-digit display unit plus max(1e-5,abs(raw)*1e-11)

tiny_integration.scope: Pipeline integration only; cannot establish credit-policy performance

reproduction_limits: The full measured end-to-end driver has fixed local source/runtime pins and is not included or claimed portable.
Published patches and options reproduce the source-policy configuration; direct-MPS runs omit discovery, generation, API checks, separation, source checking, and archival costs.
Raw artifact hashes identify the retained evidence; the compact projection is not a complete raw-data archive.
Lower bounds are numerical reports from the original integer security master, conservatively adjusted for printed rounding; no independent dual or exact-rational proof is supplied.
Security scope is the 192 line outages listed by the input, not all 210 lines, AC feasibility, or generator contingencies.
